purpose: README illustration snapshots from real Bayesian samples of the current log-odds model

model.formulation: logit(theta[t,j]) = logit(r[t,j]) + log_alpha[j]; alpha[j] multiplies workforce odds
model.endpoints: theta=0 for r=0; theta=1 for r=1

preprocessing.missing_ratios: Existing analysis sigmoid extrapolation, without driver modifications

sampling.api: pm.sample with analysis.build_pymc_model; automatic installed NUTS backend
sampling.seed_policy: Independent deterministic integer random_seed per run; PyMC spawns chain RNG streams internally

convergence_screen.criteria: No divergences or reported tree-depth hits; all rank Rhat <= 1.01; all bulk and tail ESS >= 400. A screen, not proof of convergence or accurate rare-tail estimation.

illustration_prior.method: pm.sample_prior_predictive; independent generative prior draws, not MCMC

diagnostics.helper: arviz_stats on xarray Dataset extracted from DataTree
limitations: Two chains and these diagnostics do not prove convergence; PyMC recommends at least four chains for robust diagnostics.
Very small posterior tail probabilities remain Monte Carlo estimates; bulk/tail ESS is not a guarantee of threshold accuracy.
A plotted zero means no observed alpha>=1 events, not exact zero probability.
No independent uncertainty interval is plotted; event counts and available threshold indicator MCSE/ESS are recorded per lag.

plotting.alpha_normalization: weights=1/(ALL draws * bin width), preserving omitted prior tail mass
plotting.probability_method: Existing plot_delay_sweep on all raw alpha samples from all 21 lags

remaining_issues: pyproject.toml remains malformed and untouched; installed python3 was used directly.

post_generation_formatting.note: Only formatting changed after sampling; input_sha256 retains the exact source hash used for generation.
